latest_release.name: Penny 3.2.1
latest_release.body:
**Maintenance release: no behaviour change.** Penny works exactly as in 3.2.

## Changes
- **Readable source.** Runtime JavaScript, CSS and HTML are formatted with Prettier 3.3.3. Before formatting, the longest line was 6,217 characters; 99% of lines now fit in 100. The checks that confirm nothing changed:
  - The parsed JavaScript is identical for all 10 files.
  - In a browser, computed styles, text and layout are identical for every element on the page and in all 10 dialogs, at both 320 px and 1280 px.
  - The test suite, frozen before formatting, passes 639 of 639.
  - A manual smoke test of the live site passed.
- **One version source.** The `VERSION` file holds the version, and a test checks every copy against it.
- **Leaner repository.** The documentation is reduced to the README, the changelog, the security review, the dependency list and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. The v3.2 process records and evidence remain at tag `v3.2`.
- **Security fixes** (merged after 3.2):
  - GitHub Pages now publishes only the app's runtime files.
  - The Docker port is bound to localhost.
  - The nginx Content Security Policy is complete.
  - Workflow actions are pinned by commit SHA.

## Assets
- `PennyExpenseManager-v3.2.1.zip`: the full source at this tag (`git archive`). SHA-256 is in the `.sha256` file.

Live app: https://debasisr66.github.io/PennyExpenseManager/
Full details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/debasisr66/PennyExpenseManager/blob/v3.2.1/CHANGELOG.md)
